purpose: Remember the things you mean to do until you have done them.

actions.name: addTodo
actions.description: Add a todo with this text; it starts not done.

actions.name: completeTodo
refuses: a todo that does not exist

actions.name: deleteTodo
actions.description: Remove this todo from the list.
refuses: a todo that does not exist

near_miss: a list where ticking a todo deletes it, so you can never see what you finished
misfits: a long list with no way to clear the finished todos
